senses.gloss: गद- + अग्रज गद- + अग्रज, m. the elder brother of Gada, a name of Kṛṣṇa.

1. गद् गद्, i. 1, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., MBh. 13, 1138),
 1. To recite, MBh. 3, 2642.
 2. To speak, Rām. 4, 5, 31; to speak to, with acc. of the person and of the object, Rām. 2, 36, 1.
 गदित, Reckoned up, MBh. 3, 13425. n. Speech, Śāk. d. 81, v. r.
 --Comp.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass., गद्य, n. A prosaic composition, MBh. 3, 966.
 --Desid. जिगदिष, To desire to speak, MBh. 12, 1604.
 --With the prep. नि नि,
 1. To declare, MBh. 1, 4223.
 2. To speak, Rām. 2, 40, 10. Pass. To be named, MBh. 1, 5308.
 निगदित, n. Speech, Bhāg. P. 8, 21, 5.
 --With प्रति प्रति, To answer, MBh. 13, 5887.
 --With वि वि, विगदित, Spread, Rām. 2, 35, 15.
 --Cf. Goth. quithan; Engl. quoth; perhaps also βάζω (cf. गद्गद).
† 2. गद् गद्, i. 10, Par. To thunder.

गद गद,
 I. m. i. e. 1. गद् + अ,
 1. Speech, a spell, MBh. 1, 1787.
 2. Disease, Śṛṅgārat 14.
 3. The younger brother of Kṛṣṇa MBh. 1, 7992.
 II. f. दा, A club, Rām. 5, 80, 4.
 --Comp.
गदिन् गदिन्, i. e. गदा + इन्, adj. Having a club, Bhag. 11, 17.

गद्गद गद्गद, i. e. duplicated 1. गद् + अ, adj., f. दा, Faltering, Suśr. 2, 254, 10; Rām. 3, 3, 13.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. βαμβαίνω and βαβάζω, frequent. of βαδ = 1. गद्.
गदा- + धर गदा- + धर, m. a name of Kṛṣṇa, Bhāg. P. 1, 8, 39.
